attempts.narrative: Shot starting guard optic successfully, flanked west, consulted paused map, reloaded. Vaulted low cover and sprayed without connecting further kills. Recovered Mara while taking fire. Turned only about 19 degrees with 260 ADS look units and missed enemy, nearly died. Switched pump breacher and shot further misses while retreating into cover. Shield regenerated while moving. Reached Heart but initial hold E failed outside receiver reach (5.8m then 9m); corrected backward/right and recovered Sera. Attempted east push, ran into low cover, vaulted and moved around it. Died during final approach/hold before recovering Elian. Early screenshot named terminal was actually still playing at 00:41, not a death; true terminal is attempt1-east-hold.jpg.

attempts.classification: fresh full-run attempt via visible START FRESH
attempts.narrative: Killed starting guard with shorter optic burst. Chose east flank and sprint, overshot north to Heart consoles, then corrected south/east. Two E holds failed outside reach while current guidance remained pinned to Mara. Consulted map and selected Elian (visible 9m). Dashed/moved north and attempted hold; died before recovery. Did not restart again.

gameplay.reason: Optic opening kill, phase dash, regenerating shield, cover and non-linear receiver order give real decisions. My two deaths felt consequential. However much of my play devolved into collision correction and blind offscreen damage, and I could retrieve cores while leaving enemies largely alive.

presentation.reason: Cohesive rain, cyan/amber palette, reflective wet paving, large relay landmark and strong title/end typography create atmosphere. Repeated blocky robots, blank glowing monitor surfaces and sparse geometric props limit finish.

usability.reason: Paused map, selectable objectives, clear reload/ammo and visible START FRESH are useful. First friction was mapping movement around low cover: ordinary forward holds repeatedly ended against obstacles. Pinned west guidance while exploring east made my navigation harder until explicit map selection.

readability.reason: Health/ammo, large receiver signs and danger wedges are clear. Most auxiliary labels and map legends are tiny at 1280x800; minimap lacks immediate intuitive obstacle reading. A nearby receiver still required several trial moves to reach, and offscreen threat identity did not tell me an actionable escape direction.

AAA readiness.reason: Strong art direction for a browser slice, but visible geometry/robot variety, environmental density, combat feedback and onboarding/navigation clarity do not meet my AAA expectation. No claims about performance certification: driver reported software WebGL fallback.

strengths: Memorable relay landmark and coherent rainy industrial setting
Optic aiming immediately produced a critical kill
Paused selectable facility map and fresh restart functioned
Shield recovery let a damaged run continue and recover a second core
first_friction: Low cover collision and imprecise movement/receiver reach were the first recurring friction after the satisfying opening kill.
objections: Very small peripheral typography and repeated overlapping guidance demand attention during damage
Enemy fire often arrived from outside view while I worked out receiver approach
My aim corrections under ADS were much smaller than expected; substantial misses are preserved

tested: paused facility map and Elian selection
coverage.limitations: Paused screenshot-based synthetic play. No audio or certified GPU/frame-time assessment. Two failures do not establish full mission balance.
